newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Colombia Davivienda buys Venezuela Banco Republica.
newsitem.headline: Colombia Davivienda buys Venezuela Banco Republica.

text.p: Colombia's Corporacion Colombiana de Ahorro (Davivienda) bought Venezuela's state bank Banco Republica at auction for $57.56 million, said Esther de Margulis, president of state Deposits Guarantee Fund Fogade.

Davivienda beat Ecuador's Banco del Pichincha which offered $52.5 million. Fogade had set a base price of $24 million for the bank, which was taken over in January 1995 during the 1994-5 financial sector crisis.
Davivienda and Banco del Pichincha were competing in a second round as the two highest bidders after a first round of seven bids.
Banco Republica has 69 branches throughout the country and had total assets of 97.574 billion bolivars ($201 million) to December 31, 1996, Fogade said.
